mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact potential split, static law and weak metric variations, Hodge/tensor symbols, P=0 reduced scalar action, aligned high-frequency shift reduction, rank loss and sign counterexample, dimensional screening arithmetic.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic rational expressions with positive K,a0,gamma,eta,beta,k; IEEE double arithmetic for illustrative SI screening only.
mathematics.conventions: c=1, signature (-+++), K=4piG, P is a spatial covector, k>0, beta>0; principal aligned block only for nonzero P.
inputs: Symbolic action and frozen-principal perturbation definitions in checks.py

bounds.zero_field: all positive symbolic coefficients and k>0; k=0 not reduced
bounds.polarized: aligned high-frequency principal block; not a global background solution
bounds.tensor: wavevector rotated to z, both TT polarizations and arbitrary P components
